question: Yamini Krishnamurthy, who received the Padma Vibhushan Award in 2016, is an Indian dancer in which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mungara Yamini Krishnamurthy is an Indian dancer of** Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi **styles of dancing.
 
• Her dancing career brought her many awards, including the **Padma Shree (1968), Padma Bhushan (2001), and Padma Vibhushan (2016).**
 
• She was honored with the "Natya Shastra" award by the Shambhavi School of Dance at "Nayika-Excellence Personified" on the occasion of Women's Day on 8 March 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
